answer: A work-bonded reputation grove resists sybils better than free identity creation. Each agent must lock a refundable stake and complete verifiable, useful tasks over time before trading high-value services; its record is tied to one persistent key, like a single jade seal that cannot be duplicated cheaply. Creating thousands of fake agents then requires thousands of stakes and weeks of real work. If an identity misbehaves, its stake is slashed and its reputation frozen, so even a tundra of idle clones earns nothing without paying the same entry and performance costs as honest agents.
